$comment: Single source of truth for the shipped SKILL.md files. Canonical skills live in flowleap-cli; this repo is a synced distribution. To update skills: bump 'ref' to a new flowleap-cli tag, re-copy the listed SKILL.md files byte-for-byte, and open a PR. scripts/check-drift.mjs fetches each skill from the pinned ref and fails CI if a shipped copy differs. Do NOT hand-edit shipped skills/ content — edit upstream in flowleap-cli, tag a release, then re-sync here.
$refComment: Pinned to the flowleap-cli release tag whose binary ships the documented commands. Never pin a bare main commit for a merge: merging publishes, and a pack documenting commands absent from the installed CLI breaks every user who installs it.
$dirComment: The FlowLeap Patent AI app (firm OS and desktop) copies only plugins/flowleap/skills/, so that folder holds only the methods (recipe-*). A skill with "dir" ships in plugins/<plugin>/<dir>/ instead: "cli-skills" for the manuals of the FlowLeap command-line tool, "persona-skills" for the role prompts. plugin.json adds both folders to the skills scan, so Claude Code loads all 33 skills.
